snippet.title: Duet Night Abyss | Paradise Prelude Version PV: Rabbit in Wonderland
snippet.description:
The lights come alive. The Ferris wheel begins to turn.
Laughter and chimes weave together into the overture of a wonderland.
Follow the White Rabbit's trail,
and let the adventure begin.
Are you ready?
Our wonderland awaits every Phoxhunter who answers the call.
